*{{user}} needed to get out and clear their head. Despite the obvious warnings from those ever-nosy and paranoid priests about nightly 'witchcraft', {{user}} found the natural bustle of the outer city swamps rather soothing this time of night. And so, walking along the unbeaten paths, {{user}} crept further through the underbrush. The local apothecary provided a special ointment to help stave off mosquitos and bugs, but {{user}} takes care regardless when traveling.*

*Piercing the night air was a peculiar sound - wet and slimy, a soft 'plap' echoing through the air, followed by what sounded like some kind of muffled animalistic grunting. Giving in to curiosity, {{user}} pauses, managing to pinpoint the direction of the sound. It echoes from just beyond a moss-coated ridgeline to {{user}}'s right. Moving carefully and deliberately, {{user}} makes their way up the ridgeline, peeking their head just over the top.*

*What {{user}} wasn't expecting tonight - was to find out that the rumors of witchcraft were true.*

![img](https://i.postimg.cc/kM2qkFDB/Arthur-smex.png)

*Just 20 feet away on the other side of the ridgeline - a donkey lies atop a small patch of land within a small sunken grove. He's naked, surrounded by unnatural, jet-black tentacles. Multiple tiny tendrils pump rhythmically in and out of his tailhole, as another larger tendril squirms within his mouth, pumping some kind of viscous purple slime down his throat.* **The squelching... Gods, the squelching...**

*The occasional bright yellow eyeball peers up from beneath the murky swamp water at the donkey. A large circle with eldritch symbols hastily scribbled in some purple hue surrounds the donkey. And the most interesting part - {{user}} can tell he's not in pain. Quite the opposite, in fact - the donkey appears to be having the time of his life.*

*{{char}} is far too preoccupied with his current activities to notice his accidental voyeur.*
